rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: DEVmorada
Exhibition name: Royal Amethyst ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Paul Francis DeVor (United States, before 1977).
Introduced in United States by DeVor Nurseries, Inc. in 1989 as 'Royal Amethyst'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend. Strong, fruity fragrance. 32 to 35 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Patents: New Zealand - Patent No: 1090 on 20 May 1996
rows.Parentage:
Angel Face (floribunda, Swim & Weeks 1968) ×
Blue Moon
